_: THE ON-THE-RECORD REGISTER FOR VIMLENDU JHA, read by scripts/lib/situation-render.mjs and printed on every active-situation page. It exists because an environmental organisation whose director is on national television about Himalayan floods should not publish a flood page that does not say so, and because the alternative — a generated paragraph of opinion — is the one thing this repository will not write in anybody's voice, least of all a named person's.
_rule: EVERY ITEM IS SOMETHING THAT WAS ACTUALLY PUBLISHED, WITH A LINK THAT RESOLVES. Nothing here is a paraphrase, a summary of a position, or a quotation reconstructed from memory. A title is the platform's own title, verbatim. If an item cannot be linked it does not belong here.
_matching: `hazards` decides which events an item appears on. A page shows the items tagged with its own hazard first, then `general`. An item tagged for no hazard and not general never appears, which is the safe default for something added but not yet placed.
_titles: Titles of YouTube items are copied verbatim from data/media/youtube-index.json, which recorded them from the channel on 2026-08-22, hashtags and all. They are not tidied: an edited title is no longer a quotation of what was published.
_dates: ABSENT WHERE UNKNOWN, and that is deliberate rather than lazy. data/media/youtube-index.json did not record upload dates, and a date on a citation is a claim. An item with no date prints without one.
_open: VIMLENDU'S PERSONAL X HANDLE IS @vimlendu, given by the owner on 2026-08-28 and recorded here as whose:'person'. It is FIRST in `channels` so the section leads on him rather than on the organisation's account, which is the distinction a reader of a 'what Swechha says' band actually needs. INDIVIDUAL POSTS ARE NOT LISTED and should not be invented: an item in `items` is something published with a link that resolves, and a post about a specific event has to be identified by somebody who can see it. Add them with kind:'post' when there are ones worth naming; until then the handle is the link and the page says so.
